by Micah Walter on 02 MAR 2026 in Amazon Elastic Kubernetes Service , Amazon Location , AWS Backup , AWS Elemental MediaConvert , AWS Security Hub , Strands Agents Permalink Share

Earn AVIXA CTS renewal units
Analog Way is an official AVIXA Certified Technology Specialist (CTS) Renewal Unit Provider. Our Level 1, Level 2 and Level 3 certification programs count toward the renewal of your CTS, CTS-D or CTS-I credential. So does the LivePremier™ from A to Z online course.
FAQ
💡 What is the difference between the Online Courses and the Certification Programs?
The Online Courses are an 4 to 8-hour, self-paced online trainings that aim to introduce and familiarize you with our products. Many find that the basic configuration and operation training in this course suites their needs.
The Certification Program is a 2 to 4-day, deep dive into the product. For rental and staging professionals and power users, this course covers everything there is to know about configuring and operating a device.
💡 What’s the difference between an “Level 1” certification and an “Level 2” certification?
“Level 1” and “Level 2” indicate the length of our certification programs.
Level 2 Certifications are typically 34-day classes while Level 1 Certifications are 2-day classes.
💡 Do the Certification Programs have prerequisites?
While there are no mandatory prerequisites for our Certification Programs, we do strongly recommend that you take the online course prior to attending a certification class. Doing so will allow you to focus on the more complex topics taught in the class.
💡 Where are training and certification classes held?
Currently, all training and certification classes are held at our Analog Way location in Buford, GA and Antony (France). Please contact us for questions regarding on-site or virtual training.
💡 I have a team of operators that need to be certified. Will you travel to us?
For larger teams, sometimes it makes more sense for us to travel to you. Please contact us for questions regarding on-site or virtual training.
💡 Do the certification programs count toward my AVIXA CTS renewal?
Yes. Analog Way is an approved AVIXA CTS Renewal Unit Provider, so our Level 1, Level 2 and Level 3 programs each earn renewal units toward your CTS, CTS-D or CTS-I credential. The LivePremier™ from A to Z online course does too. Ask your instructor for the number of units awarded for the session you attend.
